messages:
Sara C.: @channel quick sync — Cascade Health asked for a bespoke SLO report (uptime + p95 latency + credits calc) covering the onboarding window (last 30 days). Renewal was flagged as at-risk in the renewal WG. Can eng/ops produce a single CSV they can consume? :wave:
Tom E.: Yep, I can pull the metrics. Can you confirm the required intervals? 1m or 5m? Also do they want per-route breakdown or overall?
Mike O.: Per-route please — customer specifically called out API -> generate and embeddings routes. I'll run the report and include the credit calc using our SLO rubric.
Jess S.: I can book a 30m enablement to walk them through the report and remediation options. Prefer next Tue morning. I'll capture feedback and any ask lists.
Tom E.: Quick export command I typically use (will run against prod-agg):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/usage/v1/slo?customer=cascade-health&start=2026-02-01&end=2026-03-03&granularity=5m" -o cascade_slo.json
```
I'll convert to CSV and drop to the reports bucket.
deploy-bot: nightly-agg job finished 2026-03-03T03:45:00Z — 0 errors. CSV available at s3://redwood-reports/cascade/20260303.csv
Mike O.: Pulled initial numbers. Summary: uptime = 99.87% (target 99.9) => potential partial credit; p95 latency (generate) = 420ms (target 300ms) => SLA breach for latency band. I'll add a row-level calc like:
```
customer,metric,target,observed,credit
cascade-health,uptime,99.9,99.87,0.03
cascade-health,p95_generate,300,420,0.07
```
Sara C.: OK thanks. @Ava L. from Sales will need a one-pager for renewal communications that includes offered credit, timeline, and remediation plan. Ava, can you draft an email template with numbers and next steps?
Ava L.: On it — will draft and share a first pass by EOD.
Jess S.: Two action items for enablement: (1) show where latency regressed (top traces/routes) (2) collect customer use cases to suggest batching/caching improvements. I'll add both to the invite and the slide deck.
Tom E.: Quick question — do we want to proactively recommend quantization/parallelization options for their Dedicated pool? That could meaningfully cut p95.
Mike O.: Yes — I'll include model/instance suggestions and a ballpark cost delta in the report. Also adding a short remediation timeline (config + testing steps).
Sara C.: Perfect. Goal: CSV + one-pager + enablement invite by EOD tomorrow. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: report export job triggered — id: re-3345678911
